label: Google AdMob
terms_note: Google Cloud project + AdMob account; OAuth2 read-only reporting scopes; free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Google Cloud project; AdMob API scopes admob.readonly / admob.report)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** for our purpose — the AdMob API is publisher revenue reporting, not ad buying.Confidence: **high**.
auth: 1. Google Cloud project, enable AdMob API.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the AdMob API enabled.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admob.readonly (or admob.report); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

me.note: GET /v1/accounts: the AdMob publisher accounts the credentials can access ({account: [{name, publisherId, reportingTimeZone, currencyCode}]}).

list_accounts.note: GET /v1/accounts. `id` is the publisher id (pub-…) used as account_id by get_report; `name` is the resource name accounts/pub-…. Only the first page is returned (pageToken paging).

get_report.note: POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/networkReport:generate with a reportSpec over DATE and APP and metrics IMPRESSIONS, CLICKS, ESTIMATED_EARNINGS (account_id is the publisher id pub-…). AdMob is a publisher (monetisation) platform: earnings are revenue in micros of the account currency (6381903 = 6.38), dates are YYYYMMDD. The header/footer elements of the streamed array are dropped. `campaign_id` is not applicable.

not_offered.list_campaigns: AdMob is a publisher monetisation API; its v1 surface is accounts, networkReport and mediationReport only ("The AdMob API allows publishers to programmatically get information about their AdMob account", https://developers.google.com/admob/api/reference/rest). There are no advertiser campaigns.
not_offered.update_budget: No campaigns or budgets exist in the AdMob API (https://developers.google.com/admob/api/reference/rest).
not_offered.pause_resume: No campaigns exist in the AdMob API (https://developers.google.com/admob/api/reference/rest).

evidence: host admob.googleapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)

spec https://admob.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
scopes admob.readonly: all listed in the discovery document
